paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.72 as of 2026-08-26, with a decrease of 4.91% from the prior close and 20.95% over the last 23 sessions.

There have been various SEC filings, including a Form 4 on 2026-08-18, a Form 10-Q on 2026-08-14, and multiple 8-K filings. Insider activity includes an officer, director, or 10% holder buying, selling, or being granted company stock, as reported in the Form 4 filing.
